SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM artists

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM works

SELECT coalesce(sum(anon_1.downloaded_pages), ?) AS coalesce_1, coalesce(sum(anon_1.registered_originals), ?) AS coalesce_3, coalesce(sum(anon_1.verified_originals), ?) AS coalesce_5, coalesce(sum(anon_1.unverified_originals), ?) AS coalesce_7, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (coalesce(work_revisions.type, works.type) = ?) THEN ? ELSE coalesce(work_revisions.page_count, works.page_count) END - coalesce(anon_1.usable, ?) > ?) THEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(work_revisions.type, works.type) = ?) THEN ? ELSE coalesce(work_revisions.page_count, works.page_count) END - coalesce(anon_1.usable, ?) ELSE ? END), ?) AS coalesce_9 
FROM works LEFT OUTER JOIN work_revisions ON work_revisions.id = works.default_revision_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT assets.work_id AS work_id, sum(CASE WHEN (assets.role = ? AND assets.state = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS downloaded_pages, sum(CASE WHEN (length(assets.relative_path) > ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS registered_originals, sum(CASE WHEN (assets.state = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS verified_originals, sum(CASE WHEN (assets.state = ? AND length(assets.relative_path) > ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS unverified_originals, sum(CASE WHEN (length(assets.relative_path) > ? AND (assets.state NOT IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?))) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS usable 
FROM assets JOIN (SELECT revision_assets.asset_id AS asset_id 
FROM revision_assets JOIN works ON works.default_revision_id = revision_assets.revision_id UNION SELECT assets.id AS asset_id 
FROM assets JOIN works ON works.id = assets.work_id 
WHERE works.default_revision_id IS NULL AND assets.revision_id IS NULL) AS anon_2 ON anon_2.asset_id = assets.id JOIN works ON works.id = assets.work_id LEFT OUTER JOIN work_revisions ON work_revisions.id = works.default_revision_id 
WHERE coalesce(work_revisions.type, works.type) = ? AND assets.role = ? OR coalesce(work_revisions.type, works.type) != ? AND assets.role = ? AND assets.page_index < coalesce(work_revisions.page_count, works.page_count) GROUP BY assets.work_id) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.work_id = works.id 
WHERE (works.pixiv_illust_id NOT IN (SELECT archive_intents.pixiv_illust_id 
FROM archive_intents 
WHERE archive_intents.mode = ?))
